title: Test for Unsaturation
page_title: Test for Unsaturation | Cambridge (CIE) AS Chemistry Revision Notes 2023

blocks.md:
- Halogens can be used to test if a molecule is **unsaturated **(i.e. contains a double bond)
- Br<sub>2 </sub>(aq) is an orange or yellow solution, called **bromine water **and this is the halogen most commonly used
- The unknown compound is **shaken **with the bromine water
- If the compound is unsaturated, an addition reaction will take place and the coloured solution will decolourise

blocks.alt: Diagram showing the addition reaction of bromine with ethene, forming 1,2-dibromoethane, resulting in the decolourisation of bromine water.
blocks.caption: The decolourisation of bromine water by an unsaturated compound as a result of an addition reaction
